_comment: Terms the translator must NOT reinterpret. Keep this list SHORT.
NLLB already preserves ordinary proper nouns - measured on this project's
own clips it kept 15/16 (David Malan, CS50, Harvard, edX, YouTube,
Apple TV, Scratch, Barton, Stark, Legolas, Thor, Hulk, Fury, Romanoff,
Rogers). Adding those here would only make things worse: masking a word
starves the model of context and the rest of the sentence degrades.
Only list words that are BOTH a common noun and a name in your material -
the ones the model genuinely cannot resolve. 'Captain' is the example:
as a rank it really is 'Dai uy', but as what people call Steve Rogers it
Keys match whole-word and case-sensitively. "*" applies to every source
language. Delete the entries below if they do not apply to your video.
